## Summary

**Branch:** `feature/deterministic-cookie-store` (created from `master`, pushed to origin; remote head matches local `f4329d5`)

**New module `httpx/_cookiestore.py` (672 lines):**
- `httpx.CookieStore` exported publicly, a `MutableMapping[str, str]` usable anywhere `cookies=` is accepted (including `Client`/`AsyncClient`).
- **Limits:** `max_cookies` / `max_cookies_per_domain` validated (TypeError for non-int, ValueError for negative); deterministic eviction by oldest creation, per-domain first then global.
- **Extraction:** parses multiple `Set-Cookie` headers and combined values, splitting only on commas followed by a `name=` token while respecting quoted values — so `Expires=Wed, 09 Jun ...` commas don't break parsing. Empty/malformed cookies ignored; value-less `Domain`/`Max-Age`/`Expires` ignore the whole cookie; unknown attributes ignored; empty values valid.
- **Matching:** host-only cookies only go to the exact setting host; `Domain` cookies are case-insensitive domain-matches sent to subdomains; default path derived from request path; invalid/non-`/` paths fall back to default; RFC 6265 path matching (`/sub` matches `/sub` and `/sub/x`, not `/submarine`); `Secure` only over https.
- **Prefixes:** `__Secure-` requires Secure + https; `__Host-` additionally requires no Domain and `Path=/`.
- **Expiry:** `Max-Age` precedence over `Expires`; `<= 0`/past dates delete existing matching cookies without storing; invalid dates don't prevent storing.
- **Ordering:** replacement treats cookies as newly created; sending sorts by longer path first, then oldest creation.
- **API:** `extract_cookies`, `set_cookie_header`, `set`, `get` (raises `CookieConflict` on ambiguity), `delete`, `clear`, `update` accepting `CookieStore`, `Cookies`, `CookieJar`, dict, and list-of-tuples. Empty-domain cookies (mapping/list inputs or `set()`) are sent to any host matching path rules.

**Integration:** `Request(cookies=...)`, client construction/property/merge/redirects preserve `CookieStore` instances; `Cookies` remains unchanged as the default.
